name: NextXen Pre-Order Manager for WooCommerce
author: nextxentech

sections.description:
NextXen Pre-Order Manager for WooCommerce lets you turn any WooCommerce product into a pre-orderable item — with a release date, automated order completion, customer emails, and flexible payment options. Start capturing revenue before your product is ready to ship.

Whether you’re launching a new product line, running a made-to-order business, or building hype around a limited release, this plugin gives your store a complete, professional pre-order system.

🔗 Plugin Website | Documentation | Support

Free Features

Pre-Order Any Product
Enable pre-orders on simple, variable, composite, bundle, and booking products with a single checkbox. Customers see a customizable “Pre-order now” button and an availability message.

Release Date & Countdown
Set an optional availability date and time. WP-Cron processes pre-orders after the release date: paid physical orders move to Processing, eligible virtual orders to Completed, and unpaid orders request payment. Scheduled processing depends on WordPress cron running.

Product pages display a countdown automatically for future release dates. Configure its visibility, heading, and seconds under WooCommerce > Settings > Pre-Orders > Product countdown.

Use the [npom_countdown] shortcode to embed a live countdown timer anywhere on your site.

Two Payment Models
– Upfront (pay now): Full payment collected at checkout. Order stays “Pre-ordered” until the release date.
– Upon release (pay later): No charge at checkout. On release, customers receive a payment link by email. Automatic charging requires a gateway integration that implements this plugin’s pre-order payment hooks; saving a card alone does not enable automatic charging.

Optional Pre-Order Fee
Add an extra charge on top of the product price (e.g., a reservation fee). It appears as a separate line item in the cart.

Six Email Notifications
All emails are configurable from WooCommerce → Settings → Emails:
– New Pre-Order (admin)
– Pre-Ordered Confirmation (customer)
– Pre-Order Available / Released (customer)
– Pre-Order Cancelled (customer + admin)
– Pre-Order Date Changed (customer)

My Account — Pre-Orders Tab
Customers can view and cancel their pre-orders from the standard WooCommerce My Account area.

WooCommerce Blocks Compatible
Supports Cart and Checkout Blocks, block-based product pages, and the compatible WooCommerce product editor.

HPOS (High-Performance Order Storage) Compatible
Fully declared and tested with WooCommerce’s custom order tables.

WooCommerce Subscriptions Compatible
Pre-order subscription products. No charge at checkout — the subscription starts and the first payment is collected on the release date. Requires WooCommerce Subscriptions 6.2.0+.

Translation Ready
All strings use the nextxen-pre-order-manager text domain. Compatible with WPML, Polylang, and Loco Translate.

Premium Features

Upgrade to NextXen Pre-Order Manager for WooCommerce Premium for advanced tools that serious store owners need:

🔒 Deposit / Partial Payments
For upfront pre-orders, collect a fixed-amount or percentage deposit at checkout. On release, a follow-up order requests the remaining balance by email. Fulfillment stays on hold until that balance is paid. Deposit amounts appear in the order screen and CSV export.

🔒 Quantity Limit Per Product
Cap the total number of pre-orders accepted. Shows a “Only X slots remaining!” urgency notice when running low. Automatically closes pre-orders when the cap is hit — even under concurrent traffic.

🔒 Admin Dashboard Widget
Statistics cached for five minutes on your WordPress dashboard: active pre-order count, revenue, new/completed/cancelled this month, and a list of upcoming releases in the next 30 days.

🔒 CSV Export
One-click export of all pre-order data (Order ID, Status, Customer, Product, Release Date, Payment Type, Deposit, Balance, Total, Date Created). UTF-8 BOM included for Excel compatibility.

🔒 Priority Support
Skip the queue and get direct help from the NextXen Technology team.

👉 View Premium Plans

Supported Product Types

  • Simple
  • Variable
  • Composite (WooCommerce Composite Products required)
  • Bundle (WooCommerce Product Bundles required)
  • Booking (WooCommerce Bookings required)
  • Mix and Match (WooCommerce Mix and Match required)
  • Subscription / Variable Subscription (WooCommerce Subscriptions 6.2.0+ required)

System Requirements

  • WordPress: 6.0 or higher
  • WooCommerce: 7.0 or higher
  • PHP: 7.4 or higher

Source Code & Build Tools

PHP, CSS, and browser JavaScript are included in this package. The editable Pay Later gateway source is assets/js/npom-gateway.js; its distributed copy is build/gateway/index.js. Countdown and admin-manager styles are in assets/. The build/ directory also contains the bundled product-editor, admin, datepicker, and shortcode scripts.

The development checkout includes scripts/build-gateway.cjs. Run npm run build:gateway there to regenerate the gateway bundle and its asset hash. Run npm test for JavaScript checks. There is no general npm run build command for the legacy bundles.

Project repository: https://github.com/NextXen-Technology/nextxen-pre-order-manager-for-woocommerce

External Services

This plugin integrates the Freemius SDK for optional account connection, Pro licensing, trials, updates, and checkout. When you choose to connect or purchase, the SDK communicates with Freemius and may send account information, site URL, and plugin/environment details needed for these services. Optional diagnostic sharing is controlled through the SDK consent flow.

Freemius terms: https://freemius.com/terms/
Freemius privacy policy: https://freemius.com/privacy/
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Log in to your WordPress admin panel.
  2. Go to Plugins → Add New Plugin.
  3. Search for NextXen Pre-Order Manager for WooCommerce.
  4. Click Install Now, then Activate Plugin.

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin zip file.
  2. Go to Plugins → Add New Plugin → Upload Plugin.
  3. Choose the zip file and click Install Now.
  4. Click Activate Plugin.

After Activation

  1. Go to WooCommerce → Settings → Pre-Orders to configure global settings.
  2. Open any product, go to the Pre-Orders tab, and enable pre-orders.
  3. Set a release date, choose the payment model, and save the product.
  4. Your product is now available for pre-order.

Full setup guide: nextxentech.com/docs/woocommerce-pre-order-manager/
sections.faq:
How do I configure the product countdown?

Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Pre-Orders > Product countdown. Enable or disable the timer, edit its heading, and choose whether to show seconds. It appears for future release dates and hides when the date passes.

Is there a Pro trial?

A 14-day Pro trial is available through Freemius where offered by the configured plan. A payment method is required. Review the checkout terms before starting the trial.

Does it work with the WooCommerce Cart/Checkout Blocks?

Yes. The plugin supports Cart and Checkout Blocks and displays release information on classic and block-based product pages.

Does it work with HPOS (High-Performance Order Storage)?

Yes. The plugin is declared compatible with HPOS and works with both classic postmeta and the WooCommerce custom order tables.

Can I collect a deposit instead of the full price upfront?

Yes, but this is a Premium feature. You can configure a fixed-dollar or percentage-based deposit. On release, a separate balance order emails the customer a payment link. Fulfillment remains on hold until the balance is paid.

Can I limit the number of pre-orders per product?

Yes, this is a Premium feature. Set a maximum pre-order quantity per product and the plugin handles the rest — including urgency notices and automatic closure.

What happens if a customer doesn’t have a saved payment method on release (upon release mode)?

The order moves to “Pending Payment” and the customer is sent a payment link email automatically.

Can I change the release date after orders have been placed?

Yes. Go to WooCommerce > Pre-orders > Actions > Change release date. Select the product, enter a future date in the store timezone, and choose whether to notify customers.

Can customers cancel their own pre-orders?

Yes. From the My Account → Pre-Orders tab they can cancel an active pre-order. Refunds must be processed manually from the order screen.

Is this compatible with WooCommerce Subscriptions?

Yes. Requires WooCommerce Subscriptions 6.2.0 or later.

Is it translation ready?

Yes. All strings use the nextxen-pre-order-manager text domain and a .pot file is included.

Where can I find the documentation?

Full documentation is at nextxentech.com/docs/woocommerce-pre-order-manager/

Where can I get support?

Free support is available via the WordPress.org plugin forum. Premium customers get priority support at nextxentech.com/support/.
sections.changelog:
2.0.5

  • Keep Cancel row actions visible without hovering.
  • Show readable pre-order status badges, including draft/uninitialized orders, and a descriptive column heading.

2.0.4

  • Fix bulk-action selection, invalid order handling, and deleted product/customer admin errors.
  • Validate release-date changes and preserve existing dates on invalid input.
  • Restrict product-ID search to enabled pre-order products and add a Settings link to the manager.
  • Fix the dashboard CSV security token, upcoming-release limit, and store-timezone date display.
  • Escape customer/product list values and clarify gateway requirements for automatic charging.

2.0.3

  • Prevent duplicate release messages when block templates also run classic WooCommerce hooks.
  • Add a product-page release countdown with enable/disable, heading, and seconds controls under WooCommerce > Settings > Pre-Orders.
  • Hide countdowns when release dates expire, without reloading the page.

2.0.2

  • Restore missing storefront defaults without overwriting customized or intentionally hidden messages.
  • Show release dates in block-based product templates and product collections.
  • Restore pre-order button labels and cart release-date information on installations missing display settings.

2.0.1

  • Merge Free and Pro into one Freemius source package with a 14-day, payment-required Pro trial.
  • Update Freemius SDK to 2.13.4.
  • Fix Blocks Pay Later availability, saved gateway settings, disabled gateways, and server-side checkout validation.
  • Preserve carts on failed additions; fix all customer email resend actions and authorize customer cancellation by order ownership.
  • Fix repeated deposit calculations, quantities, Blocks metadata, balance currency and taxes, balance payment emails, and fulfillment holds.
  • Enforce quantity caps in units with final checkout locks; neutralize CSV formulas.
  • Verify WordPress 7.1 and WooCommerce 10.7 with HPOS and traditional order storage.

2.0.0 — 2026-04-12

  • New: Freemium model — core pre-order features are now free; advanced features require a Premium license.
  • New: Premium — Deposit / Partial Payments (fixed amount or percentage; balance order created on release).
  • New: Premium — Per-product Quantity Limit with low-stock urgency notice and automatic closure.
  • New: Premium — Admin Dashboard Widget with live stats and upcoming releases.
  • New: Premium — CSV Export (nonce-secured, UTF-8 BOM, Excel-compatible).
  • New: Premium — WooCommerce Subscriptions compatibility (requires Subscriptions 6.2.0+).
  • New: Freemius SDK integrated for license management, automatic updates, and upgrade flow.
  • Improvement: Plugin action links updated — free installs show an “Upgrade to Premium” link.
  • Improvement: Product tab upgrade notice shown to free users listing locked premium features.
  • Fix: Subscriptions compat class always loaded (static helpers available) but only instantiated for premium.
  • Fix: All premium classes safely skip loading when no license is present — no fatal errors.

1.0.1 — 2026-03-25

  • Initial release.
